title: List Products Response
description: Canonical product offers and continuation state. Every product carries product_id and name; other compact detail fields follow the request's fields selection. Legacy named-format identifiers are never returned. This response never contains proposals or proposal-lifecycle fields.

outcome.description: Whether this response carries a product page or confirms that the selected feed has not changed.

collections.description: Experimental (media_buy.collection_cards). Full collection objects for collections referenced by the collections selectors of products on this page, de-duplicated across those products: at most one entry per (publisher_domain, collection_id). Sellers MUST NOT include a collection that no product on the page references and SHOULD include every referenced collection; buyers resolve an omitted one from the publisher's adagents.json. These are convenience copies: adagents.json remains the root of authorization, and a copy is never authorization evidence. Present only alongside products, so never on an unchanged outcome.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted when this is the last page.

feed_version.description: Opaque version of the selected offer feed. For wholesale webhook consumers this is the same scope-keyed token carried as wholesale_feed_version on product.* and wholesale_feed.bulk_change notifications.

pricing_version.description: Opaque version of the selected pricing layer.

incomplete.description: Usable partial response with explicitly missing product-list scopes.
